tools.name: probe_domain_aso_score
tools.description: Run the free live 47-check ASO readiness audit. Returns score, HTTP signals, missing signals and $19 Express / $49 Self-Serve x402 Base USDC links; remote timeouts can produce unavailable signals.

tools.name: compare_domain_aso_scores
tools.description: Compare two public domains using the free live ASO audit. Returns both scores, missing signals and score_delta (domain_a minus domain_b).

tools.name: lookup_domain_aso_teardown
tools.description: Search 2,458 audited SaaS domains by domain or brand. Returns up to 12 teardown links; an empty list means no indexed match.

tools.name: generate_domain_aso_router
tools.description: Generate a free starter router locally, targeting <15ms generation, for Cloudflare Worker, Next.js, FastAPI, Astro/Remix or Nginx. Returns code for four discovery routes; review before deployment. No network audit or deployment.

tools.name: create_aso_pack_order
tools.description: Create an unpaid $19 Express 8-file or $49 Self-Serve 26-file ZIP order. Returns order_ref, Base Mainnet USDC details, x402 URL and no-account AnonPay XMR URL. No payment is sent; XMR is verified within 24h. Reuse idempotency_key to recover a retry.

tools.name: claim_aso_pack_download
tools.description: Verify a Base USDC transaction or check order status with its download_token. Returns a direct ZIP URL, actual archive file manifest and receipt only after settlement. Pending, mismatched or replayed payments never unlock a pack.
